BeachAccess.note: No beach or holiday icon in Tecton: the sun (light-mode) stands for the "Vacation" folder.

Bluetooth.note: No Bluetooth icon in Tecton: the link icon (pairing a device) stands for the Bluetooth setting.

Cloud.note: No cloud icon in Tecton: the database icon (stored online) stands for the "Web Clipboard" menu item.

Fastfood.note: No food icon in Tecton: the leaf (co2-leaf) stands for the "Eat" timeline step.

FormatBold.note: No text-formatting icons in Tecton: line-weight (heavier strokes) stands for bold, distinct from italic and underline in the same toggle group.

FormatItalic.note: No text-formatting icons in Tecton: the pen (annotate) stands for italic, distinct from bold and underline in the same toggle group.

FormatUnderlined.note: No text-formatting icons in Tecton: the horizon line stands for underline, distinct from bold and italic in the same toggle group.

Phone.note: No phone icon in Tecton: the chat icon (a conversation) stands for a call.

PhoneAndroid.note: No mobile-device icon in Tecton: the panel icon stands for the phone option, next to the window icon used for laptop and TV.

PhoneMissed.note: No phone icon in Tecton: the notification bell stands for a missed call.

Print.note: No printer icon in Tecton: the report icon (a document) stands for printing.

Wifi.note: No Wi-Fi icon in Tecton: the pulse icon (a signal) stands for the Wi-Fi setting.
